Subject: Fwd: Private Offer: NovaRetail + Redwood — Approval request (rev-share / discount / term exceptions)

Forwarding NovaRetail request and asking for an exception approval. Key points and my read: 

- ARR expectation: NovaRetail plans to commit to $480k ARR across three business units (est. first-year gross spend ~$360k after requested discounts).
- External asks: 35% first-year discount (they want 24-month term), 15% revenue-share paid to NovaRetail, and change to standard termination notice (90 days).
- Standard Redwood policy: marketplace private offers typically cap partner rev-share at 10% and discounts at 20% without exec sign-off. Term length 12 months typical; legal prefers 30 days termination.

Deal economics (back-of-envelope):
- List ARR: $540k
- Requested first-year net: ~$351k (35% off list) -> heavy hit to unit economics but high strategic value due to channel reach and potential upsell.
- Marketplace fees (AWS) estimated ~12% of paid list; with a 15% payout to NovaRetail this materially reduces gross to Redwood.

Asks for leadership: 
1) Exec approval to exceed discount cap and permit 35% first-year discount for 24 months on this private offer.
2) Approve partner rev-share at 15% (vs 10% standard).
3) Legal to accept 90-day termination with mutual early-exit clauses; finance to accept the temporary margin profile with milestone-based review at Q2.

Attachments: Draft_Private_Offer_AWS.docx, Deal_Economics.xlsx (I uploaded the calc sheet).

Quick suggested compromise if you prefer: approve 30% discount + 15% rev-share for the first 6 months, then re-price to standard discount levels after milestone review.

Can you advise next steps? If approved, I will: (a) prepare private offer doc, (b) open DocuSign, (c) coordinate marketplace listing with AWS partner ops.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — Cloud & Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Private Offer: NovaRetail + Redwood — Approval request (rev-share / discount / term exceptions)

Marissa — brief recommendation below and asking for your signoff.

Summary: NovaRetail is a strategically valuable channel partner in retail tech; the ARR and three BU rollout justify an exception, but we should limit long-term margin exposure.

Recommended approvals (conditional):
- Approve 30% first-year discount (instead of their 35% ask) on the private offer for a 12-month initial committed term.
- Approve 15% partner rev-share to NovaRetail, but structure as a time-limited payout: 15% for the first two quarters post-go-live, then step down to 8% thereafter unless renewed by exec review.
- Legal to accept 90-day termination for the private offer specifically, but include a mutual early-exit clause and require NovaRetail to provide monthly revenue reports and usage telemetry for first 6 months.
- Require finance to sign off on final modeled unit economics and a Q2 milestone review (health check + re-price trigger).

Rationale: 30% + time-limited rev-share preserves most of their ask while protecting Redwood margins and giving us clear gating metrics. If Marissa signs off I will draft approval memo and route to legal + finance for countersigning.

Attachments: Deal_Economics.xlsx

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
